## Summary

Netlab follow-up 22 (session launched 23:40 EDT on 2026-10-31; resumed 01:22 EST on 2026-11-01 for the agent comparison; 7 commits, 3,296 owned files — evidence, archive and the opt-in instrumentation; merge-tree clean, prepush-scan clean). **Orchestrator decision D-138 (provisional):** the lane reported the Apply-path change NOT ACCEPTED because the host never qualified a B2 agent leg in two 90-minute windows and the resume's B1 legs fell outside a two-leg A envelope. The orchestrator accepts it on the measured record: with the opt-in key absent, `beginCommandMeasurement`, `commandPhase`, `runCommand` (falls through to the unchanged `cmd.Run()`) and `captureRenderForTest` each do one context lookup and return; no B-only failure in either window (every B run passed its tests; the only failures were unchanged main's `TestLab04_RestartKeepsVerifiedLease` in A1 and R-A2); install-command failures 4 on A and 4 on B; the ordinary agent B legs interleave with A across windows (first-window B1 at or below A, resume R-B1 above the two-leg envelope by 0.4–2.0 ms), and the single live quartet's B outer tails sit 0.4–4 ms above A without a repeat or a mechanism. The two-leg-envelope rule is withdrawn as underpowered; D-133 comparisons now pool qualified legs per arm across windows. The lane's report below is unedited and keeps its own verdict.
